headline: Main's last red: papersplay's ink gates now sample when the booth has finished painting
lede: Three pixel gates that shipped Nov 12 were calibrated on Mac Chrome and have never passed CI's software renderer — they froze every merge for four nightly runs. Slot a traced the identical failure numbers to sampling the dim pre-paint phase of the day changeover, taught the gates to wait for the settled frame, and re-pinned two floors to a CI margin with dark controls intact. PR #2169 (static green) unfreezes the factory the moment it lands.

notes.text: #2147 STRIDELINE resumed from a lapsed slot-b lock and re-verified end to end: horsecheck 32/32 fresh — the gallop demo is done, its PR sits static-green behind the freeze.

The fix for main is harness-only: settle() max-of-retry sampling with content-gated plateaus; bulletin floors unchanged, aside tag floors moved 30→10 px against a solo-shift control that still demands exactly zero.
Byte-identical numbers across four trees is not flake — it is determinism; probe the dim→clean series before touching thresholds.
